Fishing lures are items that allow you to increase your fishing skill for a short amount of time. There are various types of fishing lures and they may be bought from vendors or crafted by an engineer. Fishing lures create a temporary buff to fishing skill as an enchantment on your fishing pole. Fishing lures provide much greater enhancement to fishing skill than is available through other fishing gear. Most fishing lures are used by right-clicking on the lure while you have a fishing pole equipped. This consumes the lure and creates a temporary fishing skill buff on the fishing pole. This page details items obtained by fishing. There are many kinds of items that can be caught using the fishing skill, going far beyond the denizens of the deep. Containers holding long-lost loot, legendary monsters and even weapons and armor can be retrieved from the waters with enough patience, skill and time.

These tables can be sorted easily by zone name or skill level. The 100% catch skill level is the skill level at which every catch in open water is likely to result in a fish catch and the likelihood of catching vendor trash is nearly nil. Fishing from pools is always a 100% fish catch, and Fishing from open lava is nearly always 100% vendor trash.

Fishing pools, or Schools of Fish, are location objects found in different bodies of water in WoW that have a significance to the fishing profession. Typically, a higher portion of more desirable items can be fished within a fishing pool. Fishing pool is a more general term; School of Fish is a fishing pool that contains (primarily) fish. School of Fish can also mean a kind of critter object in WoW that is not directly fishable (but appears only in fishable waters), and so fishing pool is more specific as regards the fishing profession; School of Fish critter objects are not fishing pools.

Fixate is a mechanic that causes the mob to ignore its threat list and chase a specific player for a limited time. Mobs introduced in Mists of Pandaria mark their current fixate target with an overhead mark resembling a pair of eyes. The fixated player is supposed to run away and kite the mob around. Some fixate debuffs on players also give them a speed boost (Raigonn is an example).

__NOTOC__ Flameguards are fire elementals found in Baron Geddon and Shazzrah's room in Molten Core. They spawn linked with one Firewalker and either two Lava Elementals or a Lava Reaver as part of a Lava Pack.
The Flame Deflector is a temporary shield from fire damage. It can be used from inventory and does not have to take up an equipment slot like a trinket. The Deflector can be used by non-engineers.
Flash Bomb causes all beasts to flee from the user. It can be used on any mob labeled as a beast, as well as hunter's pets, Druids, when they are in an animal form, and Shamans in Ghost Wolf.
Flash Pellets were low level bullets that added more damage than the Crafted Light Shot.

Flamecrack is a fire based AoE spell used by certain types of Mobs such as Volchan and Bael'Gar. It causes 1,250 fire damage to all nearby enemies and additionally stuns them for 4 seconds and can't be interrupted. Since Patch 1.10, it no longer stuns but only knocks back, and is interruptible.
The Flarecore Gloves are crafted with Tailoring (300); taught by Pattern: Flarecore Gloves, a Thorium Brotherhood reputation reward.
Flarecore Leggings is one of several pieces of Flarecore armor used by casters for fire resist.
The Flarecore Mantle is a set of Tailor-made fire-resistant shoulder protection. This is a great piece of gear for any cloth caster who is venturing in the Molten Core or Blackwing Lair.
Flamescarred Girdle is a Level 48 quality Leather Belt that improves Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.
Flame Mantle of the Dawn is a special enchantment for shoulder armor that adds fire resistance.

Flame Crest is a Horde outpost in the Burning Steppes. It is located on a small outcropping of rock, only accessible by crossing a crude bridge. There is a small cave in the back where Kibler lives with the talkative parrot Opus. Eitrigg and Ariok use the outpost as their base of operations when planning an attack against the Blackrock clan.
Flame in a Bottle is looted from the Box of Incendiaries in the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Flamewaker Legplates are the only legplates with Fire and Shadow Resistance other than the Tier 2 ones.
Flash Bomb Recipe is a neutral quest in which engineers receive the schematic for .
__NOTOC__ Four Flamewaker Elites are flamewakers found guarding Majordomo Executus in Molten Core.
Flamewaker Healers are flamewakers found in Molten Core. Killing Flamewaker Healers will give +4 reputation with the Hydraxian Waterlords.
__NOTOC__ Flamewaker Priests are flamewakers found in Molten Core as guards of . Killing Flamewaker Priests will give +20 reputation with the Hydraxian Waterlords.
__NOTOC__ Flamewaker Protectors can be found in Molten Core. Killing Flamewaker Protectors will give +20 reputation with the Hydraxian Waterlords.
Flamestrider Robes is a Level 50 quality Leather Robes that improve Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.
__NOTOC__ Flame Spessarite is a gem used mostly in Jewelcrafting.
Flame Cap is a herb found exclusively in Zangarmarsh in Outland. The spawn rate however seems to be quite low.
Flamescale Leggings is crafted from Pattern: Flamescale Leggings.
Flamebane Helm is a head plate armor made by Blacksmiths allied with the Aldor. It has particularly good Fire Resistance.
Flamebane Bracers is plate wrist armor made by Blacksmiths allied with the Aldor in Burning Crusade. It has particularly good Fire Resistance.
Flamebane Breastplate is plate chest armor made by Blacksmiths allied with the Aldor. It has particularly good Fire Resistance.
Flamebane Gloves are plate hands armor made by Blacksmiths allied with the Aldor. They have particularly good Fire Resistance.
Flameheart Bracers are cloth bracers designed to be used for fire resistance purposes.
Flaming Incinerator drops from Sandarr Dunereaver in Zul'Farrak.
Flamehandler's Gloves are a quest reward from Marking the Path.
Flashfire Girdle is an epic mail belt for elemental and resto shamans.
The Flame of Darnassus is obtained when a Horde character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Darnassus.
The Flame of Ironforge is obtained when a Horde character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Ironforge.
The Flame of Stormwind is obtained when a Horde character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Stormwind.
The Flame of Orgrimmar is obtained when an Alliance character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Orgrimmar.
The Flame of Thunder Bluff is obtained when an Alliance character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Thunder Bluff.
Flamewaker Imps are fel imps located in Hellfire Peninsula. They are guarded by Heckling Fel Sprites.
Flameweave Cuffs are a pair of Level 52 quality Cloth Cuffs that improve Intellect, Stamina and Haste.
Flamekin Sprites are flamekin found in the Burning Steppes. They travel in groups of up to five.
Flaming Torch drops from Sunfury Flamekeeper in Netherstorm.
Flamescale Dragonspawn are black dragonspawn found in western Burning Steppes.
Flamecloth Stave is a random drop from mobs between the levels 32 to 47.
The Flame of Blackrock Spire is located in the Blackrock Spire.

The Flamescale Armor set is a 3 piece Bind on Equip (BoE) mail armor set which can be crafted by leatherworkers once they reach skill level 350. Character level 69 is required to equip any piece of the set.
The Flame of Byltan is located in the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas.
The Flame of Imbel is located in the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas.
The Flame of Lahassa is located in the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas.
The Flame of Samha is located in the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas.
